[[Jade Bow (boss)|Jade Bow]] is an unnamed [[Jade construct]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Ice Floe]]. 

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Ice Floe}}

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Determined Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Healing Spring}}
* {{skill icon|Oath Shot}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Whirling Defense}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Mursaat Garments]]
* [[Mursaat Token]]

== Notes ==
* It shares its spawning points in the Ice Floe with [[Mursaat Elementalist (boss)]], [[Mursaat Mesmer (boss)]], [[Mursaat Monk (boss)]], [[Mursaat Necromancer (boss)]], and [[Jade Armor (boss)]].
* You can walk from [[Thunderhead Keep]] and look round the corner to see if it has spawned.
